issues.description: The template's simulate_msd_one_round function is annotated to return list[float], but the problem statement and the solution both specify/implement a return type of tuple[float, float] (error rate, acceptance rate). This mismatch in the template's type annotation can confuse students about the expected return value shape and may cause type-based test assertions or misunderstandings when implementing the function.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the return type annotation of simulate_msd_one_round in the template to -> tuple[float, float] and ensure the docstring describes the returned (error_rate, acceptance_rate) tuple. This aligns the template with the problem statement and the provided solution.
